Q: Finding out the "one line" operation between objects of the same class A:

Offtopic:

When you publicly inherit from std::map, you lose thread safety. Such inheritance means that an object of that type can be implicitly upcast to std::map, and some code may perform operations on the map without a lock.

So basically, this kind of design is invalid.

Note that there are also many other member functions of std::map that can be invoked directly on your type, and they will not be thread-safe.

Q: OpenMPI hanging with "No protocol specified" A:

You can try export HWLOC_COMPONENTS=-gl and see if it helps.

Q: Make sure a service is instantiated A:

Since angular v19,provideEnvironmentInitializer is the way.

provideEnvironmentInitializer(() => [inject(AppService1), inject(AppService2), inject(AppService3)]),

Q: How can I implement a box shadow element in swift? A:

If you only want to round the top corners, you should set the appropriate values to CALayer.maskedCorners.
